lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kee benatee sunee prabh aap ||
lines.translation: God Himself has heard the prayers of His humble devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: rog mitaai jeevaalian jaa kaa vad parataap ||1||
lines.translation: He dispelled my disease, and rejuvenated me; His glorious radiance is so great! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਖ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dokh hamaare bakhasian apanee kal dhaaree ||
lines.translation: He has forgiven me for my sins, and interceded with His power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦਿਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
lines.transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal ditian naanak balihaaree ||2||16||80||
lines.translation: I have been blessed with the fruits of my mind's desires; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||80||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 chaupade dupade ghar 6 ||
lines.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay And Dho-Padhay, Sixth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਇਹ ਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere mohan sravanee ih na sunaae ||
lines.translation: O my fascinating Lord, let me not listen to the faithless cynic,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੋਲ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat geet naad dhun gaavat bolat bol ajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Singing his songs and tunes, and chanting his useless words. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਉ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਉ ਕਿਰਤਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevat sev sev saadh sevau sadaa karau kirataae ||
lines.translation: I serve, serve, serve, serve the Holy Saints; forever and ever, I do this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: abhai daan paavau purakh daate mil sa(n)gat har gun gaae ||1||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord, the Great Giver, has blessed me with the gift of fearlessness. Joining the Company of the Holy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਗੁਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa agah agah gun raatee nain daras ra(n)g laae ||
lines.translation: My tongue is imbued with the Praises of the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and my eyes are drenched with the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan mohi charan ridai vasaae ||2||
lines.translation: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek, that I may enshrine Your Lotus Feet within my heart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਹੂ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਏਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhahoo talai talai sabh oopar eh drisat drisataae ||
lines.translation: Beneath all, and above all; this is the vision I saw.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਈ ਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: abhimaan khoi khoi khoi khoee hau mo kau satigur ma(n)tr driRaae ||3||
lines.translation: I have destroyed, destroyed, destroyed my pride, since the True Guru implanted His Mantra within me. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨਹ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: atul atul atul nah tuleeai bhagat vachhal kirapaae ||
lines.translation: Immeasurable, immeasurable, immeasurable is the Merciful Lord; he cannot be weighed. He is the Lover of His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo saran pario gur naanak abhai daan sukh paae ||4||1||81||
lines.translation: Whoever enters the Sanctuary of Guru Nanak, is blessed with the gifts of fearlessness and peace. ||4||||1||81||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh jee too mere praan adhaarai ||
lines.translation: O Dear God, You are the Support of my breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਜਾਉ ਬਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: namasakaar da(n)daut ba(n)danaa anik baar jaau baarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I bow in humility and reverence to You; so many times, I am a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat ihu man tujhahi chitaarai ||
lines.translation: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, this mind thinks of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sookh dookh is man kee birathaa tujh hee aagai saarai ||1||
lines.translation: I describe to You my pleasure and pain, and the state of this mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too meree ot bal budh dhan tum hee tumahi merai paravaarai ||
lines.translation: You are my shelter and support, power, intellect and wealth; You are my family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹਮਰੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo tum karahu soee bhal hamarai pekh naanak sukh charanaarai ||2||2||82||
lines.translation: Whatever You do, I know that is good. Gazing upon Your Lotus Feet, Nanak is at peace. ||2||2||82||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਉ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: suneeat prabh tau sagal udhaaran ||
lines.translation: I have heard that God is the Savior of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh magan patit sa(n)g praanee aise manahi bisaaran ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Intoxicated by attachment, in the company of sinners, the mortal has forgotten such a Lord from his mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)ch bikhiaa le graahaj keenee a(n)mrit man te daaran ||
lines.translation: He has collected poison, and grasped it firmly. But he has cast out the Ambrosial Nectar from his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh rat ni(n)daa sat sa(n)tokh bidaaran ||1||
lines.translation: He is imbued with sexual desire, anger, greed and slander; he has abandoned truth and contentment. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: in te kaadh lehu mere suaamee haar pare tumh saaran ||
lines.translation: Lift me up, and pull me out of these, O my Lord and Master. I have entered Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਕ ਤਾਰਨ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh pahi saadhasa(n)g ra(n)k taaran ||2||3||83||
lines.translation: Nanak prays to God: I am a poor beggar; carry me across, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||83||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan kai suneeat prabh kee baat ||
lines.translation: I listen to God's Teachings from the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਧੁਨਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathaa keeratan aana(n)d ma(n)gal dhun poor rahee dinas ar raat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Sermon, the Kirtan of His Praises and the songs of bliss perfectly resonate, day and night. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa apane prabh keene naam apune kee keenee daat ||
lines.translation: In His Mercy, God has made them His own, and blessed them with the gift of His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun gaavat prabh ke kaam krodh is tan te jaat ||1||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of God. Sexual desire and anger have left this body. ||1||
